best_match.fbbt_definition: Gustatory neuron of the adult that innervates a leg taste bristle. There are between 2 and 4 per bristle (Stocker, 1994). Their axons innervate the most ventral part of the leg neuropil (Tsubouchi et al., 2017).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00047767 'leg taste bristle chemosensory neuron', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
